acquisition method: the data-dependent top10 method was used to acquire MS data
cleavage agent: proteins were digested with trypsin using in-gel digestion
enrichment method: the total membrane fraction was isolated from two biological replicate samples
instrument: analyzed using the Orbitrap mass spectrometer... coupled to the QExactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: Using label-free quantitative proteomics, we identified proteins
precursor tolerance: with precursor and fragment mass tolerances set at 10 ppm and 0.5 Da, respectively
fragment tolerance: with precursor and fragment mass tolerances set at 10 ppm and 0.5 Da, respectively
reduction reagent: protein samples were reduced with TCEP solution
